control.reason: Applicable public behavior is implemented and exercised by the named regression suites and shared fixtures. Rust unit tests are colocated with their implementation; complete tested modules are recorded as test evidence and exports/delegates as implementation evidence. The authorization-code grant with PKCE is covered here alongside the device grant: the challenge is checked to be S256 of the verifier, the verifier never to reach the browser, a redirect answering a different attempt or carrying error= to be refused, and the token exchange to refuse cleartext to a non-loopback host.

refusal.reason: refusal_belongs_to_ask() and failure_error() live in src/refusal.rs with their vector suite colocated, as this SDK's private unit suites are, so the module is recorded as test evidence beside the errors and transport it rests on; collect_ask_reply() in client.rs applies the rule with the transport's count of asks, queries and fire-and-forget utterances inside the shared grace window, and a send whose publish never happened is dropped again. ThalovantError gains Unanswered and PolicyDenied.quota, boxed so the enum every Result carries stays inside clippy's result_large_err limit.

runtime.reason: Applicable public behavior is implemented and exercised by the named regression suites and shared fixtures. Rust unit tests are colocated with their implementation; complete tested modules are recorded as test evidence and exports/delegates as implementation evidence. HiveMind #251/#252 only changes the Python upstream client dispatcher; this consumer uses native single-dispatch transports (MCP delegates to the Node SDK), or caller-owned frame parsing in embedded C. No Python HiveMind bus dependency or slave-protocol reinjection exists here. Python now requires fixed upstream 1.1.9a1 and removes its identity-based suppression; equal independent native frames remain distinct. Reply claim metadata follows the Python string-ID contract, with first-seen ordering, case-sensitive fallback stages and legacy unstamped success. Invalid non-string stamps are ignored. Embedded C exposes bounded extraction and claim classification while its caller retains ordered IDs.
